full_judgment:
3. Ultimately, the said suit was dismissed by the judgment and decree dated 27-2-2003. Against which the plaintiff-petitioners took an appeal being Title Appeal No. 198 of 2003 before the learned District Judge, Dhaka which was subsequently transmitted to the Court of the learned Additional District Judge for disposal, who allowed the appeal on the basis of solenama by Judgment and decree dated 9-11-2005 and thereafter, the decree holder plaintiff to execute the decree filed Title Execution Case No. 9 of 2005. 

 Against the said Judgment the opposite party Nos. 2-6 filed Title Appeal No.198 of 2003, which was allowed on the basis of a solenama by compromise judgment and decree dated 9-11-2005.
